ios.desc:
A free minimalist home screen with your favorite apps, beautifully listed. That's it. 

• Beautifully Minimal
– Turn your app grid into a sleek, organized list
– Clean design with customizable alignment and text styling
– Designed to reduce clutter and visual noise

• Mindful by Design
– Focus on what matters by removing distractions
– Curate your essential apps with intention
– Make your phone feel like a tool, not a trap

• Private and Honest
– No ads
– No tracking
– No hidden analytics
– Your data stays on your device
– Open source app catalog

• Additional notes
- This app is completely free with optional donations to support the solo developer :-)
- Two widgets combine into a fullscreen list of apps, or on iOS 27 one extra-large widget fills the screen
- The app comes with the equivalent of 5 fullscreen lists (for up to 65 apps!)

I was recently looking for a simple minimalist app launcher for iPhone that would respect my privacy and didn’t come with a stupid subscription plan, so instead I made my own!
